decode.title: What does this screen mean?
decode.intro: Upload a screenshot of your Sarathi status or error page. We match it to a list of known screens and tell you the next step.
decode.privacy: Tap the picture to cover your name, application number, Aadhaar or phone number. Numbers we can read on this phone are covered for you. The picture is not stored.
decode.preview: This is exactly what will be sent:
decode.unknown: We couldn't match this screen. Pick the closest one from the list.
decode.manual: Choose your screen from the list
decode.consent: Turn on AI help in your privacy settings to read screenshots, or pick your screen from the list.
decode.off: Reading screenshots is off right now. Pick your screen from the list.
decode.scam: This doesn't look like a Sarathi page. Check it with the scam checker first.

snap.title: Road Sign Snap
snap.intro: Take a photo of a road sign. We'll find it in our sign list and show what it means.
snap.riding: Stop the vehicle first, then take the photo.
snap.none: This sign is not in our catalogue yet.
snap.unverified: Meaning not yet checked against the standard by two people.
snap.consent: Turn on AI help in your privacy settings to identify signs, or browse the sign list.
snap.off: Sign recognition is off right now. Browse the sign list instead.

coach.title: Your plan this week
coach.goal: Goal: {count, plural, one {# short session} other {# short sessions}} this week
coach.saved: Saved. You can change it any time.

commentary.title: Say it as you ride (commentary)
commentary.consent: We'll record your voice for this clip, turn it into text, then delete the audio. The text is used only for your debrief.
commentary.score: You named {hit} of {total} hazards in time.
commentary.off: Commentary scoring is off right now. Your Nazar score is not affected.
commentary.consentNeeded: Turn on voice in your privacy settings to use commentary.
